summary: Iter28 retest: all 4 fixes verified end-to-end. 17/17 pytest tests pass. (1) WS chat_ws now uses accept-then-close so clients see the documented close codes 4401 (no/invalid token) and 4403 (valid token, non-member room). (2) Loyalty router prefix renamed to /api/loyalty-superapp — /levels returns 4 entries [Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum] and /history?limit=10 returns {history: [...], count: int} with 401 for unauth. (3) /api/group/create no longer KeyError's on participant lookup — now uses str(participant.get('_id') or participant.get('id')); group create + idempotent join (first 200 success:true, second 200 already_joined:true) + my-groups enrichment all work. (4) /api/auth/ws-token now mints an explicit 300s JWT (decoded exp - now ≈ 300s, accepted within 290..310s window). Voice parse + super-app tips presets + admin WS bypass continue to work.

GET /api/loyalty-superapp/history?limit=: 200 {history: list, count: int}, count == len(history), 401 unauth
POST /api/group/create + /{group_id}/joi: /api/group/my-groups returns the group enriched with my_email + my_user_id

critical_code_review_comments: All four iter27 root causes (WS close-before-accept, loyalty prefix collision, group_orders participant['_id'] KeyError, ws-token TTL mismatch) are fully addressed. No new findings.
Optional: bump websockets test helper to use ConnectionClosed.rcvd.code to silence the 13.1 deprecation warning. Cosmetic only.

rca of the issue: All three iter27 root causes were resolved by the iter28 commits as expected: (1) chat_ws.py now calls websocket.accept() before websocket.close(code=4401|4403) so the close frame reaches the client; (2) routes/loyalty.py prefix changed to /api/loyalty-superapp, removing the route collision with loyalty_system_router; (3) group_orders.py now resolves participant id via str(participant.get('_id') or participant.get('id')) which works for V2 users whose id lives in _id; (4) auth.py /ws-token now builds the JWT inline with exp = now + 300s, matching the advertised expires_in:300.
